verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents product-type-based tax determination through product tax codes (PTCs), and it exposes a taxability_reason field explaining each tax result. That covers the core mechanism for taxability decisions and gives some visibility into the outcome. The evidence never addresses state-varying SaaS rules, digital-goods rules or bundled offerings, and a reason field falls short of visible research. Missing for 10: evidence of state-by-state SaaS taxability handling, explicit digital-goods rules, bundled-offering treatment, and visible research or citations behind each determination.

support.subject: As a founder selling software, the product gets the hard cases right — SaaS taxability that differs by state, digital-goods rules, and bundled offerings — with the research behind each determination visible

citations.quote: determining tax rates based on product type, customer location, and business location
Stripe Tax uses product tax codes (PTCs) to associate products with tax rates.
The API returns the reason for a tax result in the taxability_reason field.
